target: UTM-bundled QEMU framework, HVF, virtio-ramfb, 1 vCPU, 1 GiB RAM, VirtIO keyboard/tablet

runs.command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-named-apps-exact-current-f17.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-logic-program --probe-timeclock --probe-span-strut --probe-tothefront --probe-xcaliber --probe-vocabulary --probe-demo-tictactoe --probe-demo-chess
checks: X-Caliber left/right thrusters changed the ship, Space produced a visible projectile, and Escape restored terminal command execution (40+7 returned 47).

ToTheFront selected both human players, entered the map, plotted artillery to an adjacent hex, and returned through Escape to a working shell. The harness exits after this branch, so this run did not execute the other flags in the command.

runs.command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-span-strut-exact-current-f17.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-span-strut
checks: Span opened its help and bridge canvas, drew a frame, and recovered from Shift+Escape.
Strut opened its selection prompt, accepted input, drew graphics, and exited to a terminal where 40+2 returned 42; zstatus reported failed=0.

scope_note: These are headless runs using UTM's bundled QEMU framework and emulated devices against the exact current ISO. They do not establish visible UTM app-window behavior, live audio output, Pi hardware behavior, complete gameplay, or general hardware parity.
